t: Two garments named as belonging to Him
a: الْكِبْرِيَاءُ رِدَائِي وَالْعَظَمَةُ إِزَارِي مَنْ نَازَعَنِي وَاحِدًا مِنْهُمَا أَلْقَيْتُهُ فِي جَهَنَّمَ
p: Al-kibriyāʾu ridāʾī wa-l-ʿaẓamatu izārī. Man nāzaʿanī wāḥidan minhumā alqaytuhu fī jahannam
m: Pride is My cloak and greatness is My waist garment. Whoever contends with Me over either of them, I throw him into the Fire.
